description: Figure 8 presents a line plot illustrating the results of an ablation study on the recent sequence ratio ($S_r$) for the LLaMA 2-13B model, comparing the performance of different inference methods under varying memory constraints. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", ranges from 0 to 100 and is presented on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis is dual-axis: the left axis, labeled "Perplexity", ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, and the right axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", ranges from 40 to 100. Four distinct lines are plotted: an orange line with circle markers representing "Perplexity"; a red dashed line with square markers for "Full Cache PPL"; a blue line with circle markers for "GPU Mem. Ratio"; and a blue dashed line with square markers for "Full Cache GPU Mem.". As the recent sequence ratio increases from 0% to 100%, the orange "Perplexity" line shows a general decline from approximately 4.6 to 4.4, with a notable trough occurring between 40% and 60%. The blue "GPU Mem. Ratio" line exhibits a steady increase from approximately 42% to nearly 100%. The red "Full Cache PPL" line remains relatively flat near 60%, while the blue dashed "Full Cache GPU Mem." line remains nearly flat near 100%.
